pronunciation.approximation: Say "viracocha" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Wiraqucha".
pronunciation.note: The ASCII form "viracocha" is a DNS compromise; the restoration "Wiraqucha" preserves the name's scholarly dignity.

domains.title: Wiraqucha
domains.subtitle: Creator
domains.lead: Wiraqucha is creator, sky, sea foam. The name means "Sea of fat" and belongs to the incan tradition.

mythology.lead: The stories of Wiraqucha place creator, sky, sea foam at the center of a living mythological world.

myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Wiraqucha appears in incan tradition as creator, sky, sea foam. The name's meaning, "Sea of fat", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Wiraqucha in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Wiraqucha remains a touchstone for understanding incan religion, art, and identity.
